subject: maths
question: A boat can travel at a speed of 13 km/h in still water. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, then the time taken by boat to go 63 km in the opposite direction to stream is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water = 13 km/h

Speed of the stream = 4 km/h

Distance to be traveled in the opposite direction to the stream = 63 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

When traveling in the opposite direction to the stream, the relative speed of the boat is reduced by the speed of the stream.

Relative Speed = Speed of the boat - Speed of the stream

Relative Speed = 13 km/h - 4 km/h

Relative Speed = 9 km/h

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 63 km / 9 km/h

⇒ Time = 7 hours

**The time taken by the boat to go 63 km in the opposite direction to the stream is 7 hours.**
